description: Request_Hash vectors (Requirement 18.1, 18.11, design 10.5). `canonical` is the canonical JSON written by hand (sorted keys, no spaces, UTF-8 without escapes, whole numbers as integers); `sha256` is the SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes. Request vectors go through CreateAnimationRequest and canonical_hash; value vectors go through canonical_json. `same_hash_as` and `differs_from` name other vectors in the same list. Do not reformat this file with a tool that rewrites numbers (2.0, -0.0) or Unicode escapes.

request_vectors.note: concepts and forbidden_tokens are not sent: both hash as [].

request_vectors.name: emoji-not-escaped
request_vectors.note: Non-ASCII is written as UTF-8, never as a \u escape or a surrogate pair.

value_vectors.name: integer-one
value_vectors.note: 1 is not true: a boolean is never turned into a number.

value_vectors.name: whole-integer
value_vectors.note: 2 is written as 2: same hash as 2.0.

value_vectors.name: sorted-keys-nested
value_vectors.note: Keys are sorted at every depth; null and false are kept; 1.0 becomes 1.

value_vectors.name: non-ascii-and-escapes
value_vectors.note: Non-ASCII is not escaped; quote, backslash and newline use the JSON escapes.
